description: This file defines a Java class named UpdateCalendarCommandHandler which handles the 'UPDATE' command for calendars within the Fineract platform. It implements the NewCommandSourceHandler interface and processes update requests, delegating the actual update logic to the CalendarWritePlatformService.

classes.name: UpdateCalendarCommandHandler
classes.description: A Spring service class that handles incoming 'UPDATE' commands for calendars, ensuring transaction management and delegating update logic to the CalendarWritePlatformService.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Handles the command to update a calendar by calling the calendar write platform service.
